title: Change log
subtitle: Release notes maintained inside this Multica platform.

v0_3_41.title: Let the uploaded template decide the overlay
v0_3_41.summary: Prime no longer requires a QR code in the overlay; the platform applies the uploaded full transparent template unchanged, records decodable QR evidence when present, and continues to validate files, dimensions, layout, and compose evidence.
v0_3_41.change_1: Publishing and composition no longer require QR configuration or successful decoding; when an image contains a QR code, its decoded payload is recorded as non-blocking evidence.
v0_3_41.change_2: Markets without QR codes can upload and publish their full PNG templates directly; existing QR pixels remain part of any template that includes them.
v0_3_41.change_3: QC now checks template files, target dimensions, layout contracts, and full-template composition evidence.
v0_3_41.change_4: Creative Factory initialization, the default resource snapshot, and workspace bootstrap now use Prime contract v6.

v0_3_40.title: Use approved repayment rows first
v0_3_40.summary: Pre-adaptation now renders the smaller of source rows and compatible approved first-party plans, removing excess source values instead of treating the whole region as unmatched.
v0_3_40.change_1: The pre-adaptation Skill and analysis Agent now use approved first-party plans as the numeric source of truth.
v0_3_40.change_2: A source table with more rows than our library renders only the rows we actually have approved, with every frozen display value recorded in the layout instruction.
v0_3_40.change_3: Unsupported tenors such as 9 months are not filled with another tenor's amount; those source blocks remain removable.
v0_3_40.change_4: Creative Factory initialization, workspace bootstrap, and template versions now use the same matching contract.

v0_3_39.title: Restore repayment plan selection
v0_3_39.summary: When source repayment values do not directly match a frozen plan, confirmation now restores approved-plan selection instead of showing numeric blocks as ordinary empty copy.
v0_3_39.change_1: Source Analysis numeric blocks remain traceable and expose a first-party repayment-plan entry by region.
v0_3_39.change_2: The confirmation page can select an approved plan and freeze its numeric layout for the order.
v0_3_39.change_3: Leaving the plan unselected still removes the source region without copying competitor amounts.
v0_3_39.change_4: Order snapshots record only confirmed first-party plans and layouts; financial facts are never guessed silently.

v0_3_38.title: Separate generated output from source reanalysis
v0_3_38.summary: Generated materials now show their real production state while remaining available for a new confirmed order; archived images can still reanalyze their reference source independently.
v0_3_38.change_1: Generated materials show the real generated state and can be selected again for a new creative confirmation.
v0_3_38.change_2: Archived images keep a reanalysis action even when an output order already exists; rejected and non-configurable materials remain excluded.
v0_3_38.change_3: Reanalysis refreshes source analysis, while selecting again requires a new user confirmation and never copies the old order automatically.
v0_3_38.change_4: Only a real analysis-in-progress state shows the waiting-for-analysis label.

v0_3_37.title: Reanalysis entry and recommendation fallback
v0_3_37.summary: Archived images keep one reanalysis action across the material card, preview, and confirmation panel; unmatched ordinary copy is persisted as a user-confirmable recommendation.
v0_3_37.change_1: Archived images shown as analyzing expose Reanalyze in the card, preview, and confirmation panel; generated and rejected materials are excluded.
v0_3_37.change_2: The action uses one idempotent queue and shows a busy state while the request is being accepted.
v0_3_37.change_3: When no compatible approved copy exists, ordinary copy is stored as a recommended candidate with its basis and no library source.
v0_3_37.change_4: Financial values, rates, legal text, QR codes, and brand facts still require an approved source or frozen calculation before submission.

v0_3_36.title: Requeue analysis while waiting
v0_3_36.summary: Archived images keep a reanalysis action while waiting or already available, so users can recover an analysis Agent that did not run and verify new analysis logic.
v0_3_36.change_1: Waiting materials can be requeued for reference analysis without collecting them again.
v0_3_36.change_2: Available materials also expose reanalysis, which creates a new analysis version.
v0_3_36.change_3: Generated and rejected materials are not queued again, and the action is locked while the request is pending.
v0_3_36.change_4: The current workspace selection and material data stay intact while the page refreshes when analysis completes.

v0_3_35.title: Pending recommendations for unmatched copy
v0_3_35.summary: When the copy library has no compatible approved fragment, the platform now creates a safe candidate and clearly marks it for confirmation instead of treating the empty match as complete.
v0_3_35.change_1: Unmatched ordinary headlines, benefits, supporting copy, and CTAs receive a recommendation with no fabricated library source.
v0_3_35.change_2: Rates, amounts, tenors, legal text, QR codes, and brand facts still require an approved source or frozen calculation.
v0_3_35.change_3: The confirmation page labels candidates as pending and allows submission only after the user accepts or rewrites them.
v0_3_35.change_4: Creative Factory initialization now includes the updated copy-adaptation Skill and analysis-Agent contract.

v0_3_34.title: Partial pre-adaptation mapping
v0_3_34.summary: When numeric blocks cannot all be matched, the platform keeps safe mappings and sends unmatched blocks to confirmation instead of repeatedly failing the whole asset.
v0_3_34.change_1: Numeric blocks are split into renderable rows, and matched rows continue to use frozen plans.
v0_3_34.change_2: Blocks beyond plan capacity or without a match keep their source identity and remain selectable or removable on confirmation.
v0_3_34.change_3: The model now receives the same field, capacity, and frozen-value contract enforced by the backend, with one bounded correction only.
v0_3_34.change_4: Automatic continuation now has one entry point, preventing duplicate queues for the same analysis; this fix is deployed and has been rerun on both materials without creating an order automatically.

v0_3_33.title: User-confirmed creative orders
v0_3_33.summary: Collection and analysis remain automatic, but the platform no longer selects a material and creates an order after pre-adaptation completes.
v0_3_33.change_1: Completed analysis stays available for material selection and configurable copy while the user decides.
v0_3_33.change_2: A creative order is created only after the user selects materials, confirms copy, and submits.
v0_3_33.change_3: Runtime recovery repairs pre-adaptation results without creating hidden background orders.
v0_3_33.change_4: Existing orders and submitted tasks are unchanged; new collections follow the user-confirmation flow.

v0_3_32.title: Pre-adaptation stability and template parity
v0_3_32.summary: New workspaces now initialize the same Creative Factory Agents, Skills, and prompts as the current Ad Creative workspace, and collection handoff no longer stalls on unpublished seed resources.
v0_3_32.change_1: The seed copy library and default market pack are published for pre-adaptation; legacy packs with all six Prime attachments now receive the standard template contract during publish, while incomplete, incorrectly sized, or invalid-QR attachments remain blocked.
v0_3_32.change_2: Static assets without editable source copy are shown as No configurable copy, rather than as adaptation failures that keep retrying.
v0_3_32.change_3: A failed analysis-to-pre-adaptation handoff is recorded for recovery instead of being silently discarded.
v0_3_32.change_4: The collection Agent receives the reference-analysis binding from the current workspace, while user-edited Agents, Skills, and automations remain untouched.

v0_3_31.title: Collection automation prompt and binding
v0_3_31.summary: Creative Factory initialization now creates a real collection plan with the full prompt, image cap, and analysis handoff bound to the current workspace.
v0_3_31.change_1: The collection automation is assigned to the workspace's own 素材_采集 agent instead of the orchestration squad.
v0_3_31.change_2: The prompt includes competitors, market, selection rules, image-only filtering, the two-image cap, and analysis fanout.
v0_3_31.change_3: No fixed UUIDs are stored in the automation prompt; runtime values come from the workspace installation.
v0_3_31.change_4: Only the previous installer-created short default record is migrated; user-edited automations are preserved.

v0_3_30.title: Workspace Creative Factory initialization
v0_3_30.summary: Enabling Creative Factory now makes its workspace-owned agents, Skills, squad, and automation visible in the platform.
v0_3_30.change_1: Each workspace initializes its own creative agents, Skills, prompts, bindings, squad, and automation record.
v0_3_30.change_2: The standard automation list now includes Creative Factory automation with its workspace squad assignment.
v0_3_30.change_3: Re-enabling an existing installation repairs missing automation metadata without overwriting user-edited resources.
v0_3_30.change_4: Settings refreshes the Agents, Skills, Squads, and Automation lists after the capability is enabled.

v0_3_29.title: Workbench metrics and weekly delivery
v0_3_29.summary: The workbench now shows materials, generation, adoption, and weekly delivery work, while workflow details remain available for future reporting.
v0_3_29.change_1: The fourth workbench metric is now Weekly delivery, counting orders completed through adoption since the start of this week.
v0_3_29.change_2: Real image generation counts only orders with active tasks, while adoption-ready results remain separate for business decisions.
v0_3_29.change_3: Production adoption counts only order items with a complete delivery package; unfinished output is excluded from the denominator.
v0_3_29.change_4: Release notes now use platform-owned Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean content instead of internal translation keys.

v0_3_28.title: Production continuation and evidence checks
v0_3_28.summary: Creative production continuations no longer look like failures while queued or running, and each size now records the Prime, model original, and process evidence needed for completion.
v0_3_28.change_1: A parent production task stays in progress while a same-variant continuation is queued or running.
v0_3_28.change_2: The production Skill and workspace producer register Prime context, model originals, and normalized process evidence for every size.
v0_3_28.change_3: Completion now validates the required evidence and canonical assets to reduce stranded steps and missing outputs.
v0_3_28.change_4: After a restart, continuation tasks can resume missing sizes without losing the automatic recovery path.

v0_3_27.title: Automatic numeric pre-adaptation repair
v0_3_27.summary: Creative Factory now completes numeric mapping from the frozen repayment plans when harmless amount formatting differs, instead of stopping for a manual retry.
v0_3_27.change_1: Render instructions tolerate safe whitespace differences while the underlying repayment values remain strictly frozen and validated.
v0_3_27.change_2: After the single model retry still fails, the platform builds a valid card mapping from the Source Analysis numeric regions.
v0_3_27.change_3: The restart recovery scan also resumes recent manual-required states and continues them into orders, plans, and production.
v0_3_27.change_4: Manual confirmation remains only when numeric regions or frozen bindings cannot be determined safely; normal collection needs no retry click.

v0_3_26.title: Automatic recovery and production continuation
v0_3_26.summary: Creative Factory now resumes completed handoffs after a restart and reuses completed sizes when production is missing an output.
v0_3_26.change_1: Pre-adaptation validation now matches the current semantic prompt contract persisted by the workspace Skill.
v0_3_26.change_2: Production recovery reuses completed sizes and generates only missing sizes, avoiding duplicate work and token waste.
v0_3_26.change_3: After a service restart, stranded pre-adaptation results are scanned and continued into the order, plan, production, and QC flow.
v0_3_26.change_4: The accepted path completed from two collected images through three output sizes with no blocking QC failures.

v0_3_25.title: Creative Factory automatic handoff
v0_3_25.summary: Enabling Creative Factory initializes workspace-owned resources and automatically continues from two collected images through planning, generation, and QC.
v0_3_25.change_1: Each workspace now owns its Agents, Skills, prompts, bindings, and squad configuration without repeated overwrites.
v0_3_25.change_2: Collection is capped at two images, while analysis and pre-adaptation use the workspace's frozen resource versions.
v0_3_25.change_3: After pre-adaptation succeeds, the platform automatically selects a producible candidate, freezes copy, creates the order, and queues planning.
v0_3_25.change_4: Planning, image generation, and QC continue automatically with recovery paths preserved when a task fails.

v0_3_24.title: Pre-adaptation contracts and recovery
v0_3_24.summary: Pre-adaptation now validates frozen resources strictly, retries failed tasks by default, and falls back to human confirmation when recovery is exhausted.
v0_3_24.change_1: Field types and source constraints for copy, repayment plans, and numeric layouts are now explicit.
v0_3_24.change_2: Failed pre-adaptation tasks retry with the original task context without recollecting materials or changing resource versions.
v0_3_24.change_3: Exhausted recovery is saved as a human-confirmation state and can continue from the existing re-analysis entry.
v0_3_24.change_4: User-cancelled tasks are never restarted automatically.

v0_3_23.title: Workspace capabilities and platform updates
v0_3_23.summary: Creative Studio access is now controlled per workspace, with release notes kept inside the platform.
v0_3_23.change_1: Creative Studio can be enabled or disabled independently for each workspace.
v0_3_23.change_2: The capability is enforced by the API, navigation, and direct page access.
v0_3_23.change_3: The help menu and new-version announcement now open this internal change log.
v0_3_23.change_4: The requirements table now supports persisted label filters, with multiple labels using OR semantics. Workflow-created sub-issues are shown in stable execution order by workflow stage, variant, revision, and issue identifier.
